entries.test: Public evaluations of robots built on language systems of the kind criticized could establish whether they can reliably understand and carry out household requests.
entries.note: In context, success means reliable practical robot operation. The sentence asserts that the language system's limitations prevent that success.

entries.test: Published robotics evaluations and research on deep networks could establish whether robots also encounter open-ended edge cases and forget previously learned exceptional cases.
entries.note: Marcus explicitly adopts the application to robots in his own voice, although the preceding explanation quotes Craddock.

entries.test: Technical literature available by August 2022 could establish whether an established method integrated large language models with the formal verification techniques used in the cited engineering fields.
entries.note: “No obvious way” concerns the contemporary state of methods, rather than proving integration impossible.
“Hard to see how” expresses doubt about achieving safety under the stated condition, rather than a firm claim that it cannot happen.
The numerical threshold is explicit, but its acceptability is a judgment about the required standard.

entries.test: Public product availability and independent demonstrations through October 2026 could establish whether conversational household robots had materialized that reliably performed a range of everyday chores.
entries.note: In context, “should hold our breath” conveys a negative forecast about near-term availability. Several years have elapsed since August 2022, although the horizon has no exact endpoint.
